n3a3920b3b6.headline: ELSTAT: Over 27,000 new firms registered in the third quarter of 2024
n3a3920b3b6.summary: ELSTAT data show 27,106 new firms started operations in Greece in Q3 2024, up 16.1% year on year but down 13.9% from Q2. Company bankruptcies were also reported.
n3a3920b3b6.why: New business registrations are a leading indicator of entrepreneurial activity and economic momentum. Bankruptcy trends show the health of the corporate sector.

nbde365ae01.headline: Achmmach tin project, Morocco – update
nbde365ae01.summary: Atlantic Tin has finalised paperwork for a $5 million fundraising with UK-based royalty and streaming company Apex Royalties. The proceeds will be used to further develop the Achmmach tin project in Morocco.
nbde365ae01.why: Tin is used in solder and electronics, and royalty and streaming deals are a common way for junior miners to fund project development.

nc001f4370b.headline: Sterling ticks lower versus dollar in quiet session
nc001f4370b.summary: A ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah began at 4 a.m. on Wednesday, marking a potential end to 14 months of conflict.
nc001f4370b.why: Hezbollah is a Lebanon-based armed group, and the Israel-Lebanon conflict affects regional security, energy prices and investor risk sentiment in the Middle East.

ndf0fd0b038.headline: “Campanaki” KEPE for trade deficit, productivity and competitiveness of the Greek economy
ndf0fd0b038.summary: The Centre for Planning and Economic Research (KEPE) in its 2024 annual report of Greece's National Council for Productivity noted improved fiscal performance but flagged trade deficit and competitiveness issues.
ndf0fd0b038.why: Trade balances, productivity and competitiveness shape growth prospects and sovereign creditworthiness for Greece, an economy that investors track closely in the eurozone.

n9252d7d3d1.headline: Trump uses fentanyl threat to justify raising tariffs 10% on products from China, and 25% on those from Mexico and Canada
n9252d7d3d1.summary: President Trump proposed raising tariffs by 10% on all goods imported from China and by 25% on products from Mexico and Canada, citing the fentanyl threat, according to Banca March.
n9252d7d3d1.why: US tariffs on major trading partners alter import costs, supply chains and corporate margins, and can prompt retaliation that affects global trade and currencies.
n9252d7d3d1.why_moved: The proposal of higher US tariffs on China, Mexico and Canada raises expectations of costlier trade and possible retaliation, which is why markets react to such announcements.

n0e37e2d44e.headline: Pay languishes below 2008 levels as Britain lags behind rich world
n0e37e2d44e.summary: The International Labour Organisation warned that workers in Britain are worse off than in 2008, as the country lags behind other rich economies on pay.
n0e37e2d44e.why: Real wage trends shape consumer spending power, inflation pressures and the Bank of England's policy outlook for the UK economy.

na861b81dd0.headline: DEBT LEAKAGE
na861b81dd0.summary: The National Treasury plans to withhold funds from five municipalities over unpaid water bills. Water boards are owed R23.4 billion, more than 70% of it four months overdue.
na861b81dd0.why: Municipal payment arrears to water boards affect public utility finances and the fiscal transfers that the national government controls.

n9969e4f114.headline: Glencore agrees to solar plant deal with Pele Green Energy
n9969e4f114.summary: Pele Green Energy said it reached financial close on a solar plant with Glencore's South African ferroalloys unit and its joint venture partner. The deal was announced on Wednesday.
n9969e4f114.why: Glencore is a Switzerland-based diversified miner and commodity trader with large operations in South Africa, including ferroalloys smelting. Its renewable power contracts can affect energy costs for energy-intensive mining operations.

impacts.name: Glencore
impacts.why: Glencore's South African ferroalloys unit is a party to the solar plant financial close.

n2b473a1ab8.headline: Senate debates social media ban on kids under 16
n2b473a1ab8.summary: The Australian Senate was debating a ban on children under 16 from social media on Thursday, Nov. 28, 2024, after the House of Representatives had passed the measure. The debate continues.
n2b473a1ab8.why: Social media platforms earn advertising revenue from young users, so age restrictions can affect the user base and ad business of major technology companies.

n29b9d753ab.headline: EC says euro area fiscal stance to be 0.29% of GDP tighter in 2025 than in 2024
n29b9d753ab.summary: The European Commission said the euro area fiscal stance will be 0.29% of GDP tighter in 2025 than in 2024. It also found France's draft 2025 budget and medium-term debt plan in line with EU rules.
n29b9d753ab.why: The European Commission assesses fiscal plans of euro area members, and fiscal tightening can weigh on growth and influence government bond markets.

nf2662eaa72.headline: SAA to add R32.6bn to the economy by 2029-30, study says
nf2662eaa72.summary: A study projects that South African Airways will add R32.6 billion to the economy by 2029-30. The national carrier emerged from business rescue in 2021 and reported its first profit in more than a decade.
nf2662eaa72.why: South African Airways is the national carrier of South Africa, and its financial recovery affects aviation, tourism and state finances.

n45331425c5.headline: Leapmotor partners with NPK MOTOR for KD assembly project in Myanmar
n45331425c5.summary: Chinese electric vehicle maker Leapmotor signed a strategic agreement with Myanmar's NPK Motor on November 25 to launch a knock-down assembly project. Knock-down assembly involves shipping parts for local final assembly.
n45331425c5.why: Leapmotor is a Chinese electric vehicle maker, and overseas assembly partnerships expand its sales footprint in emerging Asian markets.

nc9117351fb.headline: DFM-listed Salik expands reach outside Dubai in deal with Parkonic
nc9117351fb.summary: DFM-listed toll operator Salik signed a deal with Parkonic for eWallet payments. The agreement extends Salik's reach outside Dubai.
nc9117351fb.why: Salik is a Dubai-listed toll-road operator, so its expansion affects its revenue base and growth outlook.

n5f8c5c5b9c.headline: TikTok owner ByteDance sues intern for $1.1 mn in damages over AI breach; all about the headline-grabbing case in China | Company Business News
n5f8c5c5b9c.summary: TikTok parent ByteDance reportedly filed a lawsuit in a Beijing court against a former intern over serious disciplinary violations, with damages sought at $1.1 million.
n5f8c5c5b9c.why: ByteDance is the Beijing-based owner of TikTok, one of the world's largest short-video platforms, so its legal disputes and internal controls over AI work can matter to investors in the sector.

nb9027bfb32.headline: Trump says Mexican president has ‘agreed to stop migration’
nb9027bfb32.summary: President-elect Donald Trump said Claudia Sheinbaum had agreed to stop migration, after he threatened tariffs on Canada and Mexico.
nb9027bfb32.why: Tariffs on Mexico and Canada would affect cross-border trade, including autos and agriculture, and move the peso and related North American equities.
nb9027bfb32.why_moved: The president-elect's threat of tariffs on Mexico and Canada, followed by the claim of a migration agreement, puts trade-policy uncertainty in focus for markets.

n2c147bd552.headline: Irish harmonised consumer price inflation up at 0.5% in November
n2c147bd552.summary: Harmonised consumer price inflation in Ireland sped up in November, according to data published Thursday by the Central Statistics Office.
n2c147bd552.why: Consumer price inflation drives central bank policy expectations and affects the cost of living and consumer spending in Ireland.

n0cea3d79d0.headline: Attica department stores: Investments of EUR 40 million from 2021 to 2027
n0cea3d79d0.summary: Attica department stores, a member of Ideal Holdings, plan a EUR 40 million investment programme launched in 2021 and expected to finish in 2027. The strategy was presented at a special event.
n0cea3d79d0.why: Ideal Holdings is a Greek investment holding company with retail and real estate interests, so its subsidiaries' investments affect its performance.

n0066e75cff.headline: Drama Erupts in Senate as Tinubu’s Economic Team Gains Entry to Defend Tax Reform Bills - Trending Today
n0066e75cff.summary: Tinubu's economic team entered the Senate to defend the tax reform bills, a session that reportedly turned contentious. The report gives no details on the bills' contents.
n0066e75cff.why: Tax reform changes government revenue, business tax burdens and investor confidence in Nigeria's fiscal framework.

n19868dd54c.headline: 'Loopholes’ in EU’s €100bn corporate tax avoidance fight, auditors say
n19868dd54c.summary: EU auditors said loopholes undermine the bloc's €100 billion fight against corporate tax avoidance. They said the tax havens blacklist has weak sanctions and cross-border schemes often go unheeded. The report follows a court ruling that Apple must repay €13 billion.
n19868dd54c.why: Apple is a US technology company, and EU tax rulings and enforcement affect multinational tax liabilities, reputational risk and the regulatory outlook for large corporates.

n72a52fe68e.headline: Abu Dhabi's MAIR Group to List in Abu Dhabi Next Month
n72a52fe68e.summary: MAIR Group, an Abu Dhabi investment firm active in food retail and commercial real estate, will list on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange on Dec. 9. It operates over 100 stores in the UAE under the ADCOOP and SPAR brands.
n72a52fe68e.why: Stock listings add new equity supply and investor access to a local exchange, and the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange is the emirate's main venue for equities.

n0d279026d3.headline: Sensex  falls! These  stocks fell 5% or more in Thursday
n0d279026d3.summary: The Sensex fell on Thursday, with several stocks dropping 5% or more. Among Nifty constituents, 46 stocks closed in the red and 4 in the green.
n0d279026d3.why: The Sensex is the benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange, tracking large Indian companies.
n0d279026d3.why_moved: Broad selling was visible, with 46 of the Nifty stocks ending lower and several large declines of 5% or more.

n421270f398.headline: HMRC could take two-thirds of people's pensions in new tax raid, expert warns
n421270f398.summary: An expert warned that the new Labour government could take as much as 64% of people's pensions under proposals being considered. The claim concerns proposed inheritance-related pension taxes.
n421270f398.why: Pension tax rules affect household savings, retirement planning and the flows into pension funds that invest in UK and global assets.

n8bc82eb1bf.headline: Mexican Peso Strengthens Following Sheinbaum-Trump Diplomatic Exchange
n8bc82eb1bf.summary: The Mexican peso gained strength against the dollar following a productive call between President Claudia Sheinbaum and Donald Trump. The Rio Times reported the move.
n8bc82eb1bf.why: The peso is Mexico's currency and its moves reflect investor views on Mexico-US trade and diplomatic relations.
n8bc82eb1bf.why_moved: The peso strengthened after a productive call between President Sheinbaum and President Trump, easing trade-related concerns.

n68c63a9398.headline: Dollar Hits R$6 for the First Time Amid Fiscal Package and Income Tax Reform Worries
n68c63a9398.summary: The dollar hit R$6 for the first time amid worries over a fiscal package and income tax reform in Brazil.
n68c63a9398.why: The Brazilian real is the local currency, and fiscal policy concerns often weigh on it by raising risk premiums for investors.
n68c63a9398.why_moved: Worries over Brazil's fiscal package and income tax reform pushed the dollar above R$6 for the first time.

nf4ceff328b.headline: Why have the UK migration figures been revised?
nf4ceff328b.summary: UK migration figures have been revised, with estimates typically changing as more data becomes available.
nf4ceff328b.why: Net migration figures shape UK labour supply forecasts and the economic outlook used by policymakers and investors.

n97bed74f7c.headline: Rupee falls 9 paise to close at 84.49 against US dollar
n97bed74f7c.summary: The rupee closed 9 paise weaker at 84.49 per dollar on provisional figures, weighed down by weak domestic equities and broad dollar strength.
n97bed74f7c.why: The rupee's level against the dollar affects India's import costs, inflation and foreign investor returns.
n97bed74f7c.why_moved: A negative trend in domestic equities and broad strength of the US dollar weighed on the rupee, though a mixed-to-weak tone in crude oil cushioned the fall.

nef23dd8247.headline: Mexican Exports Surge to Record Heights: October Trade Data Shows 11.2% Growth
nef23dd8247.summary: Mexican merchandise exports reached a record US$57.67 billion in October, up 11.2% after two months of decline.
nef23dd8247.why: Exports are a major driver of Mexico's economy and trade balance, closely tied to US manufacturing demand.

n17f5c91031.headline: Rental housing supply boost promised under tax tweaks
n17f5c91031.summary: As many as 80,000 rental properties are expected to be built over ten years under revised build-to-rent tax settings in Australia.
n17f5c91031.why: Build-to-rent tax incentives affect residential developers and the supply of rental housing that investors fund.

nd9d9967c88.headline: Brazilian Real Estate Market Shows Strong 2024 Performance, Faces Headwinds in 2025
nd9d9967c88.summary: Brazil's real estate market grew strongly in 2024, with São Paulo leading large increases in property launches. Analysts flag headwinds for 2025.
nd9d9967c88.why: Housing and construction are significant parts of Brazil's economy and credit cycle. Changes in property activity affect construction firms and lenders.

nfbf3014540.headline: Marketers Halt Imports, Source 148m Liters From Dangote Refinery
nfbf3014540.summary: Marketers have halted imports and are sourcing 148 million litres from the Dangote refinery, according to the report. The move affects fuel supply in Nigeria.
nfbf3014540.why: Dangote Refinery in Lagos is a large privately owned plant that can supply Nigeria's domestic fuel market. Shifts in sourcing alter import demand and local pricing.

nca62b6caca.headline: BREAKING: Senate passes Tax Reform Bills for second reading
nca62b6caca.summary: Nigeria's Senate on Thursday passed the government's four proposed tax reform bills for a second reading.
nca62b6caca.why: Tax reform changes government revenue collection and the business tax environment, which affects investor decisions on Nigerian assets.

nef6f73e292.headline: Gotion High-tech, Tsinghua University forge strategic partnership for innovation in new-generation power battery tech
nef6f73e292.summary: Gotion High-tech signed a memorandum of understanding with Tsinghua University in Beijing on November 21 to collaborate on next-generation power battery technologies and materials.
nef6f73e292.why: Gotion High-tech is a Chinese battery maker supplying lithium-ion cells for electric vehicles, so its research partnerships affect the competitiveness of the EV battery supply chain.

nf89b103486.headline: Casino operator counts the cost of going cashless
nf89b103486.summary: The leaders tasked with turning around troubled casino operator Star have given shareholders a frank assessment of the cost of going cashless, according to the report.
nf89b103486.why: Star Entertainment operates casinos in Sydney and Queensland, and its recovery plan is closely watched by investors given its past regulatory and financial troubles.

n22317d0770.headline: A social media ban for under-16s passes the Australian Senate and will soon be a world-first law
n22317d0770.summary: Australia's Senate passed a law that will make platforms including TikTok, Facebook, Snapchat, Reddit, X and Instagram liable for fines for systemic failures to stop under-16s holding accounts.
n22317d0770.why: The law would impose fines on major social media platforms, which rely on younger users for engagement and advertising revenue, so it carries direct regulatory and revenue risk.

n196c36ed84.headline: Remy Cointreau HY Profit Down; Confirms 2024-25 Objectives
n196c36ed84.summary: French spirits maker Remy Cointreau reported first-half 2024-25 group net profit of 92.0 million euros, down 18%. The company confirmed its 2024-25 objectives.
n196c36ed84.why: Remy Cointreau is a French maker of cognac and liqueurs, so its results signal demand for premium spirits in global markets.

na7818f4d06.headline: A social media ban in Australia for children under 16 is first in the world
na7818f4d06.summary: Australia's social media ban for children under 16 will be the first law worldwide to levy fines on TikTok, Facebook, Snapchat, Reddit, X and Instagram for allowing youth accounts.
na7818f4d06.why: Major social media platforms earn most revenue from advertising on user engagement, so age-based account rules and fines can affect their user base and compliance costs.

na3a995d9f2.headline: Grifols Board Announces Termination Of Discussions With Brookfield - Quick Facts
na3a995d9f2.summary: The Grifols board announced the termination of discussions with Brookfield Capital Partners UK about a potential acquisition of Grifols shares.
na3a995d9f2.why: Grifols is a Spanish plasma-therapy and diagnostics company, and takeover talks can affect its valuation and shareholder expectations.
na3a995d9f2.why_moved: The company's board ended discussions with Brookfield about a potential acquisition of its shares, removing that takeover prospect.

ncd09a608eb.headline: RBNZ juggles inflation and economic tightrope in new Trump era
ncd09a608eb.summary: The Reserve Bank of New Zealand is keeping a 'watch, worry and wait' stance as inflation eases, while President-elect Trump's strict trade pledges stoke fresh jitters.
ncd09a608eb.why: The RBNZ sets New Zealand's official cash rate, which influences borrowing costs, the New Zealand dollar and domestic asset prices.

n56f4ab7637.headline: Changan Automobile: R&D of flying car, humanoid robot technologies are underway
n56f4ab7637.summary: Changan Automobile disclosed at an investor relations event that it is already researching cutting-edge technologies, including flying cars and humanoid robots.
n56f4ab7637.why: Changan is one of China's major automakers, and its diversification into new mobility technologies shapes its long-term competitiveness.

nf146a5a04e.headline: Australian Senate Passes Social Media Ban For Young Children, Soon To Be World's First Such Law
nf146a5a04e.summary: The Australian Senate passed the bill 34 votes to 19, after the House of Representatives approved it 102 to 13, making Australia set to become the first country with such a law.
nf146a5a04e.why: Restrictions on youth access to social media affect platform operators' user growth and advertising revenue, making them relevant to technology investors.

n9fa8744280.headline: Grifols plummets on stock market after Brookfield abandons €6.5 billion takeover bid
n9fa8744280.summary: Grifols shares fell sharply after Brookfield withdrew its interest in a public exclusion offer for the Spanish healthcare company, citing disagreements over price.
n9fa8744280.why: Grifols is a Spanish plasma-derived medicines company, and takeover bids can strongly affect its share price and investor expectations.
n9fa8744280.why_moved: Brookfield abandoned its €6.5 billion public exclusion offer over disagreements on price, removing the takeover premium investors had been pricing in.

n5ef0325ac5.headline: A social media ban in Australia for children under 16 is first in the world
n5ef0325ac5.summary: Australia's law will be the first in the world to levy fines on TikTok, Facebook, Snapchat, Reddit, X and Instagram for allowing accounts for users under 16.
n5ef0325ac5.why: Meta, Snap and Reddit earn advertising revenue from young users, so fines and account restrictions can affect their user base and monetisation.

nb788426dc5.headline: French farmers wall off public buildings in protest over regulations
nb788426dc5.summary: French farmers blocked the entrances to two public buildings in Paris on Thursday. They protested regulatory constraints imposed by agencies, which they say cause losses.
nb788426dc5.why: Agricultural regulation shapes farm costs and output in France, a major EU food producer. Protests can signal policy changes affecting food supply and prices.

n58fab6cc1a.headline: China’s state media praise some US firms amid fears of a new trade war
n58fab6cc1a.summary: China's state media have praised some US firms for strong collaboration, commentary that comes as fears of a new trade war grow.
n58fab6cc1a.why: US-China trade tensions affect tariffs, supply chains and the revenue of multinational companies with significant business in China.

n206f0fc68d.headline: Iceland's pro-EU parties lead in polls ahead of snap election
n206f0fc68d.summary: Iceland's voters go to the polls on Saturday in a snap election that could steer the country towards seeking European Union membership. The issue has divided the country.
n206f0fc68d.why: Iceland is a European Economic Area member outside the EU, so a shift toward EU membership would reshape its trade and regulatory framework.

n4744281ad6.headline: French PM abandons electricity tax rise amid pressure from far right
n4744281ad6.summary: Prime Minister Michel Barnier has abandoned a planned electricity tax rise in a budget concession, though he may still face a confidence vote.
n4744281ad6.why: The French budget sets public spending and tax policy for the euro area's second-largest economy, and fiscal decisions affect French government bonds and political stability.

na09ab35668.headline: Liberal GST holiday expected to pass soon as government introduces solo bill
na09ab35668.summary: The Liberal government introduced a standalone bill for a GST holiday, which is expected to pass soon. The NDP said it would not pass the legislation if it were linked to a $250 rebate for working Canadians.
na09ab35668.why: A GST holiday temporarily removes a federal sales tax, which affects consumer prices and retail spending across Canada.

n29ae72c03e.headline: Swatch wins lawsuit against Malaysia’s illegal seizure of Pride watches
n29ae72c03e.summary: The Kuala Lumpur High Court ordered Malaysia's Home Ministry to return 172 Pride-themed Swatch watches it had seized, Swatch won the lawsuit.
n29ae72c03e.why: Swatch Group is a Swiss watchmaker, and disputes over seized inventory affect its sales and regional distribution in Asia.

neef2e73d26.headline: Mexico warns Trump tariffs would kill 400,000 US jobs, threatens retaliation
neef2e73d26.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said Mexico would retaliate if US President-elect Trump imposes tariffs, warning they would kill 400,000 US jobs.
neef2e73d26.why: Mexico is one of the largest trading partners of the United States, so tariffs and retaliation would affect cross-border supply chains and trade flows.

n0b29c89b4f.headline: Saskatchewan mid-year financial update projects $743M deficit, more than twice budget
n0b29c89b4f.summary: The Saskatchewan government's mid-year update projects a deficit more than double its budget forecast, largely due to higher crop insurance payouts after a difficult farming season.
n0b29c89b4f.why: Provincial deficits affect borrowing needs and bond issuance, and crop insurance costs reflect agricultural conditions in the Prairies.

n3ccdbfca29.headline: Possible tariffs worry Canada uranium miners as they boost output to meet US demand
n3ccdbfca29.summary: Canada's uranium miners have accelerated output and forward contracts to meet US demand after Russian supply curbs. Possible tariffs are a concern for the miners.
n3ccdbfca29.why: Uranium is the fuel for nuclear power, and Canada is a major producer, so US demand and trade policy shape miners' revenues.

n88a150ae3e.headline: Canada selects underground site to store used nuclear fuel in perpetuity
n88a150ae3e.summary: Canada has chosen a site in northern Ontario as its first deep underground depository for used nuclear fuel, following a 14-year selection process run by the Nuclear Waste Management Organization.
n88a150ae3e.why: Long-term nuclear waste storage is a major infrastructure and regulatory commitment for Canada's nuclear power sector, which relies on reactors such as those run by Ontario Power Generation.
